translated_title: Mexico Asks Washington to Detain and Extradite the Wife of Genaro García Luna
original_title: México pide a Washington que detenga y extradite a la esposa de Genaro García Luna
author: Sugeyry Romina Gándara
meta_description: President Sheinbaum confirmed Mexico has asked the U.S. to detain and extradite Linda Cristina Pereyra, wife of former security secretary Genaro García Luna, as part of an FGR investigation.
